issues.description: The origin check was replaced with `target.startsWith("https://app.example.com")`. A prefix match is not an origin match: `https://app.example.com.evil.com/phish` and `https://app.example.com@evil.com` both pass startsWith yet resolve to attacker-controlled hosts, giving an open redirect. The removed `new URL(...).origin !== TRUSTED` check was correct; parse the URL and compare the origin, don't string-prefix it.
